Name: Stardew Alchemy
Author: zirolive69
Description:
[b][u]Description:[/u][/b]
 
This Mod added  1 shop,  1 alchemy-Still , 39 objects, 1 weapon  and 3 seeds.
It starts whit year 2 and a message from the wizard, from Liz  or with pay 150000 Gold  to Krobus.
For the most recipes you need bottles buy them from Gus, find them ore make them self.
 
It give a new Shop (a Alchemy shop) the owners name is Liz.
She comes in the town in winter year 2.
She sell Potions and exchange the untempert sword to a full weapon.
 
Not every  attempt has an 100% success rate.
You can open the Spoiler or play and find the recipes self.
I wouldjust play the Mod.
 
[b]First, where I become the needed bottle´s and Seeds:[/b]
 
[spoiler]
- Buy them from Gus, Krobus, Liz and the Dwarf
- Glass Shards + Coal in Furnace (100% success// 60% big 40% Small)
- Quartz + Coal in Furnace (30%success// 15% big 15% Small)
- Trash in Recycling Machine (30%success// 15% big 15% Small)
[/spoiler]
 
[b]Second, the recipes:[/b]
 
 [spoiler]
7 different recipes:
- Trash in Recycling Machine (0,1%)
-or 6 with a good relationship (5 to 7 hearth by Krobus, the Dwarf, Demetrius, the Wizard and Linus).
 
[b] All recipes:[/b]
